import html from typing import List # Example template (the actual one should be defined elsewhere in the project) USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {writer_name}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(writer_name: str, title: str, body: str, tag_list: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- writer_name : str The name of the author. title : str Post headline. body : str Main text content. tag_list : List[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str Sanitised HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user‑supplied data esc_writer = html.escape(writer_name, quote=True) esc_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) esc_body = html.escape(body, quote=False).replace("\n", "
") # Build tags HTML tag_html_parts = [] for t in tag_list: esc_tag = html.escape(t, quote=True) tag_html_parts.append(f'{esc_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(tag_html_parts) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( writer_name=esc_writer, title=esc_title, body=esc_body, tags=tags_html )
